title: OVAL: Online Value Adaptation from Lookahead for Test-Time Alignment
desc: Instead of discarding lookahead rollouts after each decoding step, OVAL reuses them to adapt the critic for the current prompt.
zh: OVAL 把前瞻搜索得到的候选排序保留下来，用它们为当前提示在线修正价值估计，而不是在每步解码后丢弃。
figure: How segment-level planning feeds online value adaptation
figZh: 片段级规划与在线价值修正的闭环

title: Black-Box Stubborn Hallucination Detection as Chernoff Active Testing
desc: When a model gives the same wrong answer repeatedly, CHAT selects new probes to distinguish a stubborn hallucination from a reliable answer.
zh: 当模型反复给出同一个错误答案时，CHAT 主动选择追问，区分顽固幻觉与可靠回答。
figure: CHAT’s sequential test and probe selection pipeline
figZh: CHAT 的序贯检验与探针选择流程

title: Stopping Soft Reasoning before It Loops: From Impasse-Oriented Detection to Event-Level Intervention
desc: E-TRACE detects recurring semantic events during soft reasoning, rolls back to an earlier event and switches decoding before the loop takes over.
zh: E-TRACE 在软推理中识别反复出现的语义事件，回退到较早的节点并切换解码方式，以避免陷入循环。
figure: Diverging hard and soft reasoning trajectories at an impasse
figZh: 遇到推理僵局时，硬解码与软解码轨迹的分化
